n: Bias is the lean in an answer. Anthropic's Oct. 14 post on the midterms says its newest models score 99% on its own evenhandedness test, and it names two faults it still sees: caveats nobody asked for and uneven hedging between political views. The score is the company's own measure. When a tool talks politics, ask who graded it and where the voting facts came from.
